## Research and Collaboration

I am particularly interested in collaborative opportunities in causal inference for observational data, spatial and spatiotemporal statistics, environmental and health statistics, statistical methodology for clinical trials, and statistical computing.

I also welcome enquiries regarding research seminars, invited talks, statistical consulting, methodological collaborations, and academic teaching.
